room.name: Town Square
room.description: Emerald banners hang over a stone well, and every road from the square seems to be holding its breath.

companion_dialogue.line: Every road meets here. If Emerald Keep has a heartbeat, this square is where it stumbles loudest.
The banners look cheerful, but everyone keeps glancing toward the roads. Something has the whole town listening.

object.name: Weathered Mural
object.description: A weathered mural shows moonlit scholars walking through a door that is not painted on the wall.
object.interact_text: You press the moon sigil in the mural. Stone grinds beneath the square, and a hidden stair opens to the west.
object.completed_text: The mural's moon sigil is already pressed, and the hidden western stair remains open.

room.name: Guard Post
room.description: A guard post overlooks the north road, and a watchful patrol is usually stationed there.

object.name: Signal Lantern
object.description: An old green signal lantern hangs above the road map, its shutter stamped with the Town Watch crest.
object.missing_item_text: The lantern shutter is locked. A Watch Token would prove you have Sera's authority to light it.
object.interact_text: You press the Watch Token to the lantern's crest. Green light spills over the north road map, marking bandit trails in sharp lines.
object.completed_text: The signal lantern already burns green, keeping the north road marked for the Watch.

room.name: Title Street
room.description: A narrow ceremonial street runs between old town homes, its stone title markers polished by generations of careful hands.

room.name: New Moon Temple
room.description: A quiet temple of pale stone and green glass gathers moonlight even during the day. Four relic carved ornately into the silver arch.

room.name: Elder's House
room.description: The elder's house is quiet, but the scent of herbs and old books lingers in the air.

object.name: Memory Shelf
object.description: A narrow shelf holds old patrol pins, mended spectacles, and an empty place in the dust.
object.missing_item_text: The shelf has an empty space shaped by years of waiting. Something personal belongs there.
object.interact_text: You place the Faded Keepsake on the shelf. The room seems to exhale, and the old house feels less alone.
object.completed_text: The keepsake rests on the memory shelf, exactly where it was meant to be.

room.name: Elder Memory Cache
room.description: A small floor coffer opens beneath the elder's shelves, packed with supplies left for someone who remembered kindness first.

object.name: Elder Cipher Scale
object.description: A thin serpent-scale mark is scratched beneath the coffer lid, almost hidden by dust and old kindness.
object.missing_item_text: The scale-mark is written in compressed Archive shorthand. The Archive Cipher could unfold it.
object.interact_text: The Archive Cipher warms against the coffer lid. The first recovered letter is S.
object.completed_text: The translated scale-mark still reads: S.

room.name: Stewards Office
room.description: A small office situated by the Elders home, the front is marked with a lantern.

room.name: Lantern Inn
room.description: Amber lamps warm the common room, and a row of clean beds waits near the hearth.

object.name: Hearth Ward
object.description: A brass ward bowl rests beside the hearth, its rim etched with tiny healing runes.
object.missing_item_text: The ward bowl is dry. It needs a Healing Tonic before its runes will wake.
object.interact_text: You pour a Healing Tonic into the ward bowl. Amber runes flare softly around the inn.
object.completed_text: The hearth ward already glows with tonic-warmed light.

room.name: Hearth Supply Cache
room.description: The kindled hearth ward reveals a warm cubby behind the firewood, stocked with modest comforts for the road.

object.name: Hearth Cipher Scale
object.description: A soot-dark serpent scale is etched behind the firewood, too precise to be decoration.
object.missing_item_text: The mark curls into Archive shorthand. The Archive Cipher could coax it open.
object.interact_text: The Archive Cipher catches amber firelight. The second recovered letter is N.
object.completed_text: The hearth mark has already been translated: N.

room.name: Market Street
room.description: Canvas awnings snap above tidy stalls, and the smell of hot iron mingles with the crisp clink of money being counted twice.

room.name: Currency Exchange Office
room.description: A narrow office glows behind green glass lamps. Ledgers line the walls, each one chained down as if numbers might otherwise escape.

object.name: Exchange Vault Door
object.description: A reinforced green door waits behind Marlow's counter, its lock shaped like a folded leaf.
object.missing_item_text: The vault door needs the Exchange Vault Key, unless someone skilled enough can pick the lock.
object.interact_text: The Exchange Vault Key turns with a soft click, and the vault door opens into green lamplight.
object.lockpick_text: You tease the leaf-lock open with a quiet click, and the exchange vault door swings inward.
object.lockpick_failed_text: The vault's leaf-lock shifts, then snaps stubbornly back into place.
object.lockpick_missing_item_text: You need Lockpicks before you can work the vault's leaf-lock.
object.completed_text: The exchange vault door already stands open.

room.name: Exchange Vault
room.description: Green glass lamps shine over sealed strongboxes, clipped exchange notes, and a ledger that smells faintly of mint ink.

room.name: Town Jail
room.description: A clean but cheerless cell waits beneath the guard post. The door has no handle on your side, only a bail notice nailed at eye level.

room.name: Smithy
room.description: The forge roars under a roof blackened by years of useful smoke.

object.name: Jammed Grate
object.description: A warped floor grate rattles whenever the bellows breathe. Something beneath it catches the green forge-light.
object.missing_item_text: The grate is wedged too tightly to lift by hand. A sturdy pry bar would give you leverage.
object.interact_text: You lever the grate open, reaching in you turn a handle. A large trap door opens and a platform rises to take you to the mines.
object.completed_text: The grate is already propped open, its hinges complaining softly.

object.name: Cellar Door
object.description: A blacked wood door barred in iron, secured with an old padlock.
object.missing_item_text: The cellar door needs the Cellar Key, unless someone skilled enough can pick the lock.
object.interact_text: The Cellar Door Key turns with a soft click, and padlock clicks open and the bar slides free.
object.lockpick_text: You tease the padlock open with a quiet click, and the cellar door can be opened.
object.lockpick_failed_text: The padlock shifts, then snaps stubbornly back into place.
object.lockpick_missing_item_text: You need Lockpicks before you can work the padlock.
object.completed_text: The cellar door is already unlocked.

room.name: Smithy Cellar Cache
room.description: A cramped cellar beneath the opened grate holds spare forge stock wrapped in oilcloth.

object.name: Smithy Cipher Scale
object.description: A narrow serpent scale has been tapped into the cellar stone with a smith's awl and an archivist's patience.
object.missing_item_text: The scale-mark is folded into heat-stained shorthand. The Archive Cipher could read the hidden letter.
object.interact_text: The Archive Cipher reflects a line of green forge-light. The third recovered letter is A.
object.completed_text: The cellar scale-mark remains clear in your notes: A.

room.name: Forest Path
room.description: The north road narrows between listening trees. Lantern hooks line the branches, but most are dark.

room.name: Crystal Grotto
room.description: Green crystals thread through the walls like roots caught mid-song.

mining.message: A crystal seam brightens as you enter.

object.name: Whispering Vein
object.description: A narrow ore vein whispers in clipped syllables whenever your shadow crosses it.
object.missing_item_text: The vein whispers too quickly to understand. Keeper Nox's Archive Cipher would help you read the pattern.
object.interact_text: You hold the Archive Cipher against the vein. Moon-script aligns with the ore's flicker, and the whispers settle into a usable pattern.
object.completed_text: The vein has already been translated, its rhythm now familiar beneath the crystal hum.

object.name: Serpent Cipher Door
object.description: Five blank crystal scales coil around a hairline seam in the grotto wall, each one waiting for a letter.
object.password_text: You speak SNAKE. The five scales turn one by one, and a green-lit passage curls open into the stone.
object.password_failed_text: The crystal scales click once, unimpressed, and settle back into blank silence.
object.completed_text: The serpent cipher door already stands open, its hidden passage breathing cool air from within.

room.name: Arcane Thief's Cache
room.description: A crescent-shaped hideaway glitters behind the serpent door. Whoever built it loved locked drawers, clean exits, and jokes at the expense of honest locksmiths.

room.name: Mage Tower
room.description: The tower smells of candle smoke, ink, rain, and theories that should probably stay theoretical.

object.name: Archive Lens
object.description: A brass lens points toward a blank wall covered in patient chalk marks.
object.missing_item_text: The lens lacks a focusing core. A piece of Glimmer Ore would fit the cradle beneath it.
object.interact_text: You set Glimmer Ore beneath the lens. Moon-script blooms across the wall. You press the highlighted marks, stairs to the upper tower appear from the walls.
object.completed_text: The lens remains focused, and the moon-script still glows on the wall.

object.name: Archive Supply Door
object.description: A reinforced blue door set into the wall of the tower, its lock shaped like a crescent moon.
object.missing_item_text: The door needs the Archive Supply Key, unless someone skilled enough can pick the lock.
object.interact_text: The Archive Supply Key turns with a soft click, and the sturdy door opens into pale lamplight.
object.lockpick_text: You tease the crescent-lock, it opens with a quiet click, and the supply door swings inward.
object.lockpick_failed_text: The room's crescent-lock shifts, then snaps stubbornly back into place.
object.lockpick_missing_item_text: You need Lockpicks before you can work the Mages supply room.
object.completed_text: The supply door already stands open.

room.name: Archive Supply Room
room.description: A large supply room deep within the tower, it houses various tools and supplies for scholarly endeavors.

object.name: Archive Supply Cipher Scale
object.description: A serpent scale is pressed into the underside of a supply shelf, disguised as a catalog mark.
object.missing_item_text: The catalog mark compresses several letters into one silver knot. The Archive Cipher could loosen it.
object.interact_text: The Archive Cipher flattens the silver knot into readable script. The fourth recovered letter is K.
object.completed_text: The supply-room mark has already yielded its letter: K.

room.name: Ruins
room.description: Broken archways lean over the old approach to the keep, and bandit marks scar the stones.

room.name: Thorn Maze
room.description: A compact maze of emerald thorns shifts whenever you second-guess yourself.

maze.progress_message: The thorns part with a soft scrape as you follow the remembered pattern.
maze.failure_message: The maze folds around your mistake and returns you to the start of the pattern.
maze.success_message: You complete the thorn pattern, and a narrow gap opens into a hidden cache.

room.name: Hidden Cache
room.description: A tiny stone chamber hides supplies left by watch scouts and archive runners who did not trust each other but trusted preparation.

room.name: Ancient Vault
room.description: The vault hums with layered moon wards, and a silver disk waits beyond a vigilant construct.
room.locked_message: The vault door is locked tight. You need the Vault Key to enter.

room.name: Moon Threshold
room.description: Moon-silver arches frame a narrow corridor where every footstep rings louder than it should. The passage remains open between the old vault and the sanctum.

room.name: Sanctum
room.description: An outer sanctum opens beneath a pale dome. The heart chamber waits beyond doors veined with green light.

room.name: Heart Sanctum
room.description: Roots of emerald light coil around a cracked crystal heart. The room waits for a lantern, a choice, and an ending.

room.name: Thornwild Camp
room.description: Canvas lean-tos crowd beneath old trees. Every rope is tied twice, as if the forest itself might wander off with the camp.

room.name: Eldergrove
room.description: The oldest trees of the Thornwild bend inward here, their bark ridged like sleeping faces and old vows.

object.name: Buried Seed Cache
object.description: A circle of soft moss gives slightly underfoot, marked by ranger knots tied low around three roots.
object.missing_item_text: The moss is too dense to clear by hand. A Field Trowel would lift the cache without tearing the roots.
object.interact_text: You ease the trowel beneath the moss and uncover a ranger seed cache wrapped in green cloth.
object.completed_text: The seed cache is already open, its cloth tucked neatly back from the roots.

room.name: Thorn Seed Cache
room.description: The opened seed cache leads into a root-hollow where rangers hid green supplies from weather and worse company.

object.name: Thorn Cipher Scale
object.description: A little serpent scale is tucked inside a ranger knot, green thread hiding silver script.
object.missing_item_text: The knot is ordinary until the script inside it catches the light. The Archive Cipher could read it without cutting the thread.
object.interact_text: The Archive Cipher gleams through the ranger knot. The fifth recovered letter is E.
object.completed_text: The ranger knot still holds the final translated letter: E.

room.name: Bramble Overlook
room.description: A rocky shelf overlooks a green sea of thorns. Something bright is caught in the briars below.

room.name: Bramble Witch Lair
room.description: Bird bones, thorn charms, and stolen road signs hang from twisted branches around a hollow of black leaves.

room.name: Thorn Crown Grove
room.description: A circle of ancient briars forms a living throne. The air smells of rain, iron, and decisions made before language.

room.name: Ember Lift
room.description: A chain lift descends below the smithy, rattling through warm stone toward the old Emberdeep mines.

object.name: Miners' Roll
object.description: A soot-dark memorial board lists Emberdeep crews by shift mark. One empty hook waits beneath a scratched tally symbol.
object.missing_item_text: The empty hook is shaped for a miner's tally stone. Someone carried their shift mark too far into the dark.
object.interact_text: You hang the Miner Tally Stone beneath the matching shift mark. The old board settles with a soft click, and a supply niche opens beside the lift.
object.completed_text: The returned tally stone rests on the miners' roll, keeping one more name from being lost to smoke.

room.name: Miners' Supply Cache
room.description: A narrow cache beside the lift holds practical supplies left by crews who believed remembrance should come with preparation.

room.name: Ember Crosscut
room.description: Rails split through a glowing crosscut where heat shimmers above puddles of mineral water.

object.name: Heat-Locked Crate
object.description: A red-hot supply crate sits beside the rails, its latch glowing with trapped forge heat.
object.missing_item_text: The latch is too hot to touch. Heatproof Gloves would make opening it survivable.
object.interact_text: You grip the hot latch through the gloves and pull the crate open before the metal can bite.
object.completed_text: The heat-locked crate already hangs open, cooling with little offended clicks.

room.name: Ember Supply Cache
room.description: The opened heat-locked crate leads to a recessed supply niche packed by miners who expected the worst to have teeth.

room.name: Ember Pump House
room.description: Huge brass pumps sleep beneath layers of ash. Their missing gear leaves one wheel turning uselessly in place.

object.name: Pump Assembly
object.description: A brass pump assembly waits with one gear-shaped absence in its center.
object.missing_item_text: The pumps cannot run without the missing Ember Pump Gear.
object.interact_text: You fit the Ember Pump Gear into place. The pump coughs, shudders, and begins dragging smoke out of the lower mine.
object.completed_text: The pumps are already moving, drawing smoke away in steady iron breaths.

room.name: Ember Seam
room.description: A glowing seam of ore runs through the wall, pulsing like the mine has a fever.

mining.message: You chip ember-bright ore from the hot seam.

room.name: Cinder Rails
room.description: Old rails vanish into smoke, their sleepers marked by glowing pawprints.

room.name: Colossus Forge
room.description: A forge large enough for giants glows at the mine's heart. Something huge moves behind the curtain of sparks.

room.name: Caravan Road
room.description: The road beyond the market runs into dry grass, sun-glare, and the long trade route toward Vel'rasha.

room.name: Vel'rasha Oasis Camp
room.description: Green tents cluster around a moonlit spring at the edge of the desert. The water reflects constellations not visible overhead.

room.name: Caravan Bones
room.description: Half-buried wagon ribs point from the sand like the remains of a wooden whale.

room.name: Mirage Maze
room.description: The desert repeats itself in bright panels of false distance. Even your shadow seems unconvinced.

maze.progress_message: The mirage thins as you hold to the remembered star path.
maze.failure_message: The desert laughs in heat-haze and returns you to the first false dune.
maze.success_message: The false horizon splits, revealing a hidden cache beneath a white stone arch.

room.name: Mirage Cache
room.description: A stone cache rests under shade that should not exist at this hour.

room.name: Moonlit Spring
room.description: The oasis spring shines silver-blue, reflecting both the sky and a deeper sky beneath it.

mining.message: You sift ringing glass sand from the spring's moonlit bank.

object.name: Spring Reflection
object.description: The spring reflects a crooked moon that is not overhead.
object.missing_item_text: The reflection refuses to settle. A Desert Compass might anchor the true direction.
object.interact_text: You lower the Desert Compass over the water. The crooked moon straightens, and the spring remembers the present.
object.completed_text: The spring now reflects only the sky above it, which feels like mercy.

room.name: Spring Reflection Cache
room.description: With the spring's reflection cleansed, a clear pocket opens beneath the bank where moonlit water has hidden useful things.

room.name: Sphinx Court
room.description: Moonlit columns rise from the sand around a still pool. The Oasis Sphinx waits where every reflection points inward.
room.locked_message: The court folds away in mirage-light. You need the Desert Compass to hold the path steady.

room.name: Moonfall Archive Gate
room.description: A silver bridge rises from the mage tower to a ruined archive suspended over a moonlit ravine.

room.name: Scriptorium
room.description: Long desks stand beneath drifting shelves. Pens scratch by themselves, though not always helpfully.

room.name: Moon Index
room.description: A circular chamber projects silver indexes into the air, sorting every name the archive has not forgotten.

object.name: Index Prism
object.description: A prism at the center of the index spins too quickly to read.
object.missing_item_text: The prism speaks in broken archive shorthand. The Archive Cipher could slow it down.
object.interact_text: You align the Archive Cipher with the prism. Silver text steadies into readable names and routes.
object.completed_text: The index prism turns slowly now, patient and precise.

object.name: Fracture Measure
object.description: A hairline crack runs through the Moon Index's central prism, too fine to judge by eye.
object.missing_item_text: The crack is too precise for guessing. Moon Calipers could measure the fracture safely.
object.interact_text: You measure the prism fracture with the calipers. The crack resolves into a repairable lunar equation.
object.completed_text: The prism fracture has already been measured and annotated in tidy silver marks.

room.name: Moon Fracture Cache
room.description: The measured prism opens a narrow archive drawer filled with blank lunar pages and ink that has been waiting for a careful hand.

room.name: Sealed Wing
room.description: Cracked lunar seals mark a wing where the archive stored answers too dangerous to shelve in public.

room.name: Lunar Stacks
room.description: Tall shelves lean together like conspirators. Wet black footprints cross the dust between them.
room.locked_message: The stacks seal themselves behind pale script. You need the Warded Stacks Key from the Moon Index.

room.name: Warden Chamber
room.description: The archive's last sealed room holds a cold dais, a broken moon map, and a guardian that has never stopped waiting.

room.name: Concord Gate
room.description: Four empty seals ring a black door beneath the Heart Sanctum. The gate waits for thorn, ember, mirage, and moon.

object.name: Thorn Seal
object.description: The first seal is shaped like a crown of briars.
object.missing_item_text: The Thorn Seal waits for the Thorn Crown Relic.
object.interact_text: You set the Thorn Crown Relic against the seal. Green briars bloom across the gate without breaking the stone.
object.completed_text: The Thorn Seal is already alive with quiet green thorns.

object.name: Ember Seal
object.description: The second seal is a coal-black socket veined with heat.
object.missing_item_text: The Ember Seal waits for the Emberheart Relic.
object.interact_text: You press the Emberheart Relic into the socket. Heat races through the gate like sunrise under iron.
object.completed_text: The Ember Seal already glows with steady furnace-light.

object.name: Mirage Seal
object.description: The third seal is a glass ring full of roads that do not agree.
object.missing_item_text: The Mirage Seal waits for the Mirage Orb Relic.
object.interact_text: You lift the Mirage Orb Relic to the glass ring. Every false road inside it bends toward the same door.
object.completed_text: The Mirage Seal already shows one true road through its shifting glass.

object.name: Moonfall Seal
object.description: The fourth seal is a silver equation missing its final answer.
object.missing_item_text: The Moonfall Seal waits for the Moonfall Relic.
object.interact_text: You align the Moonfall Relic with the silver equation. The four seals sing together, and the Starless Gate opens east.
object.completed_text: The Moonfall Seal is complete, and the Starless Gate remains open.

room.name: Relic Harmony Cache
room.description: When the fourth seal wakes, a quiet alcove opens behind the Concord Gate with supplies gathered from all four relic roads.

room.name: Starless Approach
room.description: The world behind you becomes a green line of light. Ahead, the Starless Citadel rises against a sky with no stars at all.
room.sealed_message: The Concord Gate seals behind you. The citadel will not let the story retreat unchanged.

room.name: Citadel Forward Camp
room.description: A desperate little camp burns behind a barricade of broken black stone and green lanterns.

room.name: Void Bastion
room.description: The citadel's outer bastion is built from black stone that drinks torchlight and returns whispers.

room.name: Abyss Walk
room.description: A narrow bridge crosses a drop so deep that falling stones come back as echoes instead of sound.

mining.message: You chip cold void shards from a crack in the black stone.

room.name: Starless Keep
room.description: The inner keep has no windows, only arrow slits looking into a darkness deeper than outside.

object.name: Silent Fault
object.description: A seam in the black wall drinks sound so completely that even your breathing seems borrowed.
object.missing_item_text: The seam gives no answer by touch or sight. A Void Tuning Fork might find the ward hidden inside it.
object.interact_text: You strike the tuning fork. No sound follows, but the seam shivers and releases a cold line of starlight.
object.completed_text: The silent fault has already been tuned, its hidden ward humming below hearing.

room.name: Silent Fault Cache
room.description: The tuned fault opens a slit in the black stone, revealing final supplies wrapped in cloth that has never known sunlight.

room.name: Concord Throne
room.description: Four relic lights crawl across a black throne where the Concord Wyrm coils around Emerald Keep's stolen future.
